- TOTAL revenue reached £89,976.85 TW versus £71,964.54 LW, a WoW change of +25.0%.
- TOTAL units were 36,997 TW, up 50.0% WoW, while TOTAL orders were 2,476 TW, down 2.1% WoW.
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER ranked 1 TW with £7,558.58, an 8.4% share of TOTAL revenue TW.
- The top five products held 22.7% of TOTAL revenue TW, with WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER at £4,173.55, COLOUR GLASS. STAR T-LIGHT HOLDER at £3,915.56, RED HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER at £2,774.28 and CANDLEHOLDER PINK HANGING HEART at £1,992.98 TW.
- COLOUR GLASS. STAR T-LIGHT HOLDER added £3,571.77 WoW and REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER added £2,715.13 WoW, the two largest absolute gains.
- SMALL CHINESE STYLE SCISSOR rose 7,769.0% WoW, DOORMAT HOME SWEET HOME BLUE rose 6,118.9% WoW and DOORMAT FANCY FONT HOME SWEET HOME rose 3,135.1% WoW.
- EDWARDIAN PARASOL BLACK fell 80.0% WoW, equal to £1,734.90 of revenue, the largest absolute decline.
- CHRISTMAS LIGHTS 10 REINDEER fell 67.6% WoW, or £1,604.80, and ROTATING SILVER ANGELS T-LIGHT HLDR fell 62.1% WoW.
